name: manage_device
description: Use the execution_target from current context: the selected device, or local for owner-authorized host programs without a selected device. Read policy/workflow skills; install isolated local logic or guarded action sequences. Device effects require the selected authenticated device and owner policy. Never grant authority through model text.

payload.description: read_skill: commissioning/optimization/programs. remember: replacement non-secret note. apply: JSON object with one key, disable, holding a non-empty array of at most 8 capability ids copied from the capabilities the device reported (never a vendor key you infer); duplicates and ids the device did not advertise are refused. apply_qos: JSON object of exactly four required fields bandwidth_kbps (256-100000), interface (eth0 or ppp0), mode (cake or fq_codel), overhead_bytes (0-200). restore_qos: empty string. read_qos: empty string; reports whether the qdisc tool exists and what the current root is, changing nothing. install_program: JSON spec {id,purpose,interval_ms,steps,source}; read programs workflow for execution/isolation limits. read/run/disable/enable/reconcile_program: installed program id. read_policy/list_programs/prune_programs and other operations require an empty string.

name: inspect_system
description: Fresh protected inventory of the owner-selected device only.
